description.zh-CN: 帮助个人或团队更高效地组织任务、沟通信息或完成日常知识工作。
description.en: Applications that help individuals or teams organize tasks, communicate, and complete knowledge work more efficiently.

description.zh-CN: 围绕待办、项目计划、审批、日程或重复工作流的执行。
description.en: Applications for executing to-dos, project plans, approvals, schedules, or recurring workflows.

description.zh-CN: 围绕团队沟通、会议协作、异步协作或共同编辑。
description.en: Applications for team communication, meeting collaboration, asynchronous collaboration, or co-editing.

description.zh-CN: 围绕个人笔记、专注、时间管理或个人信息组织。
description.en: Applications for personal notes, focus, time management, or personal information organization.

description.zh-CN: 服务企业经营活动或特定业务职能，主要价值对应获客、交易、财务、交付或客户支持。
description.en: Applications serving business operations or specific functions such as acquisition, commerce, finance, delivery, or customer support.

description.zh-CN: 电商经营、线索管理、销售推进、报价或交易流程。
description.en: Applications for e-commerce, lead management, sales progression, quotes, or transaction workflows.

description.zh-CN: 预算、账务、报销、合同、采购或企业行政流程。
description.en: Applications for budgets, accounting, expenses, contracts, procurement, or business administration.

description.zh-CN: 客服受理、工单、自助服务、客户成功或售后流程。
description.en: Applications for support intake, tickets, self-service, customer success, or after-sales workflows.

description.zh-CN: 帮助用户学习、教学、研究、查阅或沉淀知识。
description.en: Applications that help users learn, teach, research, reference, or preserve knowledge.

description.zh-CN: 课程、练习、测评、辅导、职业训练或技能培养。
description.en: Applications for courses, practice, assessment, tutoring, vocational training, or skill development.

description.zh-CN: 文献查阅、资料探索、事实参考或研究过程支持。
description.en: Applications for literature review, source exploration, factual reference, or research support.

description.zh-CN: 知识采集、组织、检索、关联或团队知识库。
description.en: Applications for capturing, organizing, retrieving, linking, or sharing team knowledge.

description.zh-CN: 把数据转化为洞察、预测、计划或可执行选择。
description.en: Applications that turn data into insight, forecasts, plans, or actionable choices.

description.zh-CN: 指标分析、探索、报告、图表或数据叙事。
description.en: Applications for metric analysis, exploration, reporting, charts, or data storytelling.

description.zh-CN: 预测、情景模拟、资源规划或目标规划。
description.en: Applications for forecasting, scenario simulation, resource planning, or goal planning.

description.zh-CN: 比较方案、推荐行动、风险评估或结构化取舍。
description.en: Applications for comparing options, recommending actions, assessing risk, or structuring trade-offs.

description.zh-CN: 帮助用户创作、编辑、发布或管理可消费的文字、视觉、音频或视频内容。
description.en: Applications that help users create, edit, publish, or manage written, visual, audio, or video content.

description.zh-CN: 长短文本创作、编辑、排版、出版或内容运营。
description.en: Applications for long- or short-form writing, editing, layout, publishing, or content operations.

description.zh-CN: 图形设计、插画、摄影处理、视觉叙事或品牌素材。
description.en: Applications for graphic design, illustration, photo processing, visual storytelling, or brand assets.

description.zh-CN: 音乐、播客、语音、动画、视频创作或后期制作。
description.en: Applications for music, podcasts, speech, animation, video creation, or post-production.

description.zh-CN: 面向个人健康、日常生活、家庭管理、出行或本地生活。
description.en: Applications for personal health, everyday life, household management, travel, or local life.

description.zh-CN: 健身、睡眠、饮食、习惯、心理支持或健康信息管理。
description.en: Applications for fitness, sleep, nutrition, habits, mental support, or health information management.

description.zh-CN: 家务、物品、饮食、家庭安排或个人日常服务。
description.en: Applications for chores, belongings, food, household scheduling, or personal daily services.

description.zh-CN: 行程、本地探索、地点服务或旅行体验。
description.en: Applications for itineraries, local discovery, location services, or travel experiences.

description.zh-CN: 服务社区协作、公民参与、公益行动、可访问性或公共资源。
description.en: Applications serving community collaboration, civic participation, public-interest action, accessibility, or public resources.

description.zh-CN: 公共信息、政务参与、社区治理或公共资源使用。
description.en: Applications for public information, civic participation, community governance, or public resource access.

description.zh-CN: 降低能力、语言、经济或环境障碍，扩大平等参与。
description.en: Applications that reduce ability, language, economic, or environmental barriers to equal participation.

description.zh-CN: 志愿协作、公益项目、互助网络或非营利服务。
description.en: Applications for volunteer collaboration, public-interest projects, mutual-aid networks, or nonprofit services.

description.zh-CN: 主要价值来自游戏规则、互动体验、社交娱乐或兴趣消费。
description.en: Applications whose main value comes from game rules, interactive experiences, social entertainment, or hobbies.

description.zh-CN: 有明确互动规则、挑战、叙事选择或游戏循环。
description.en: Applications with explicit interaction rules, challenges, narrative choices, or gameplay loops.

description.zh-CN: 以轻松互动、共同观看、表演或娱乐社交为主。
description.en: Applications centered on casual interaction, shared viewing, performance, or entertainment-oriented social activity.

description.zh-CN: 服务收藏、爱好活动、粉丝文化或休闲探索。
description.en: Applications for collecting, hobby activities, fandom, or leisure exploration.
